title: charts start with story
rule: Start with the story, not the chart. Pick the relationship (comparison, trend, proportion, distribution, correlation) first. No chart if a single callout number or a table is clearer, the set is too small, or the chart needs heavy explanation. Not for decoration.
pass_when: Chart type matches the relationship; no chart when a callout or table is clearer, the set is too small, or it needs heavy explanation.
fail_when: Decorative chart; chart for a single number that a callout would carry.
overview: Choose the data relationship first; skip charts that only decorate or confuse.
apply_when: Deciding whether and which chart to use for a relationship.
not_when: Decorative charts or charting a single number a callout would carry.
agent_hint: Pick comparison, trend, proportion, distribution, or correlation first; skip decorative charts.
description: Start with the story, not the chart. Pick the relationship—comparison, trend, proportion, distribution, correlation—first. No chart if a single callout number or a table is clearer, the set is too small, or the chart needs heavy explanation. Not for decoration. Pass when chart type matches the relationship and no chart appears when a callout or table is clearer. Fail for decorative charts or charting a single number a callout would carry.
